title: GPT‑Live
summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-Live, a feature enabling real-time, live voice interactions with ChatGPT that allows users to have natural conversational experiences without waiting for complete responses to generate. The feature supports seamless back-and-forth dialogue similar to human conversation.
problem_solved: Eliminates the friction of waiting for AI responses by enabling instantaneous, live conversational interactions.
why_valuable: Makes AI interactions feel more natural and human-like, significantly improving user experience for voice-based AI applications.
